pageSealed: This page is sealed and this tab doesn't have its key.
pageNoController: The page was created but doesn't name this area's data controller yet: {error}
questionsStayed: The form's questions stayed in this area ({error}) — you can change that in the form settings.

helpers.label: Helpers
helpers.says: write in the calendar and chats

participants.label: Participants
participants.says: read pages, the calendar and chats; everyone who signs up gets it

members.label: Members
members.says: write in the group's chat and calendar

learners.label: Learners
learners.says: learn from the base, and you see their progress

passwordFirst: Enter your password first — the keys aren't open in this tab.
partlyFailed: That didn't work — part of it may already have been created.
keysClosed: The keys aren't open in this tab — enter your password to change anything here.
leaderChanges: The card and tools are changed by whoever leads the area.

summary.cardUnread: The card can't be read here — no key for the area where it's visible.
summary.afterHidden: After the event (hidden until the end)

check.noControllerGroup: No data controller — the group chat won't be created.
check.noControllerCourse: No data controller — the course page with a review for learners won't be created.
check.noController: No data controller — forms won't accept anything and chats won't be created.
check.pageController: The main page names this area's data controller.
check.pageOtherController: The main page names a different data controller than this area.
check.assignPage: Assign the page to the area
check.pageAssigned: The page names this area's data controller.
check.termMembers: Only members of “{name}” see the date — there will be no date on the cards.
check.cardPublic: The card is publicly visible — on “Events” lists.
check.cardHidden: The card isn't shown yet: the main page must be public and the card in a public area.
check.groupNoChat: The group has no chat yet.
check.members: The members' role exists — you'll create the members' link below.
check.noMembers: No members' role — without it there's no link for members.
check.public: The area is public — its page and lists are for everyone.
check.notPublic: The area isn't public — only members will see its lists and card.
check.lists: The main page has a list of events or groups.
check.noLists: There are no lists of events or groups on the main page yet.

bases.one: The course uses one knowledge base.

check.noBase: The course has no knowledge base yet.
check.learners: The learners' role exists — you'll create the link below.

learnersClosed.one: Learners can't read the area of the base {names} — they won't see it on the page.
learnersClosed.other: Learners can't read the areas of the bases {names} — they won't see them on the page.

check.learnPage: The main page has learning from the course base — the learners' link leads there.
check.noLearnPage: There's no review on the main page yet — that's where people with the link learn, also without an account.
check.revisionsAdded: The reviews are on the main page.

stray.one: A learning module on the main page doesn't send answers to the course — you may not see its progress here.
stray.other: {count} learning modules on the main page don't send answers to the course — you may not see their progress here.

check.routed: Answers from the learning modules go to the course.
check.cardUnread: The card exists but can't be read here.
check.noCard: No card — no title and description on cards and lists.
check.publishPublic: You publish in the public area “{name}”.
check.publishClosed: “{name}” isn't public — only its members will see the card, the date and the questions.
check.publishedIn: New things will be shown in “{name}”.
check.noTerm: No main date — the date on the cards and the end of the event depend on it.
check.signupOpen: Sign-ups open — the form accepts submissions.
check.signupEnded: Sign-ups closed — the event has ended.
check.formNotOnPage: The form isn't on the main page.
check.formPlaced: The form is on the main page.
check.questionsIn: The form's questions are in “{name}”, which not everyone reads.
check.questionsMoved: The questions are visible in the publishing area.
check.signupNotYet: Sign-ups don't accept yet — the main page must be public and the area must have a data controller.

image.fromPage: You choose the photo from the main page's files — add them in the page editor.
image.later: You'll choose the photo from the main page's files once you create it.
image.label: Photo

card.titleNotSynced: The card was saved, but the main page's title couldn't be changed: {error}
card.noKey: You don't have the key of the area “{name}” — choose another one in “Where it's visible”.
card.unreadable: The current card can't be read here (no key for the area “{name}”) — saving will replace it.
card.leadPlaceholder: In one or two sentences: for whom and about what.

publish.title: Publish in
publish.label: Show new things in
publish.note: The card, the main date and the form questions can be visible in another area than the data — answers, people and chats stay here. You can move each thing separately later; you publish to another area only if you lead both.

org.controller: {name} — responsible for the data of events and groups in this area and below.
org.noController: Set one — they'll be responsible for the data of all events and groups in this area and below.

course.basesSays: The course's learners learn from these bases. Each stays in its area and can also serve other courses and pages — answers from this course's modules go to the course.
course.noBaseOthers: The course's entries and questions, with a daily review for learners — a new base or the ones you already have (as many as you like).
course.noBase: The course's entries and questions, with a daily review for learners.
course.noAccess: you no longer have access to it
course.notOnMain: it isn't on the main page
course.unlinkModules: Its modules will disappear from the course's main page.
course.unlinkRole: The role “{role}” will stop reading the area “{name}”.
course.unlinkStays: The base, its entries and progress stay as they are — also in other courses that use it.
course.unlinked: “{name}” is no longer in the course.
course.revisionAdded: The review is on the main page.
course.linking: Linking the base to the course…
course.noneToAdd: There's no base you can add here: a course can use a base from an area you can let people into — not from your private one.
course.inCourseRead: This base is in the course area — learners already read it.
course.pickWarn: The base stays in the area “{name}”. The role “{role}” will get read access to it: learners with the link will see everything in this area — not just this base.

pickWarnNeighbours.one: The base stays in the area “{name}”. The role “{role}” will get read access to it: learners with the link will see everything in this area, including the base {bases} — not just this base.
pickWarnNeighbours.other: The base stays in the area “{name}”. The role “{role}” will get read access to it: learners with the link will see everything in this area, including the bases {bases} — not just this base.

course.roleWillBeMade: The learners' role will be created along the way (a dozen or so seconds).
course.settingsStay: The base's settings don't change — it can also serve other courses and pages.
course.placeToo: Add its review to the main page (answers to the course)

main.saysEvent: The page cards and lists show — with the card at the top.
main.says: The page cards and lists show.
main.noPages: You don't lead any page yet — a top-level address is claimed with a code in Pages.

sub.title: Subpages
sub.says: Programme, directions, rules — each under the main page's address.
sub.ready: The subpage is ready — add modules to it.

signupTool.title: Sign-up form
signupTool.says: First name, surname, phone, email. Answers go to this area; the questions are visible where you publish.
signupTool.moved: The questions are now visible in “{name}”.
signupTool.note: Answers always go to this area. You can change the same in the form settings.

subforms.says: Extra questions for a submission — filled in by the participant or only by leaders (notes).
subforms.ready: The sub-form is ready — add questions to it.

term.title: Main date and programme
term.placed: The programme is on the main page.
term.show: Show the programme on the page
term.linked: This date has a link or can't be read here — change it in the calendar so nothing gets lost.
term.says: Its end is the end of the event; you'll add programme points later.

pick.failed: Could not load dates from the calendars.
pick.none: There's no date to choose — a single one (no repetition), in a calendar you can write in, from a month back to a year ahead.
pick.moveAsk: Move the date to this area?
pick.moveBody: “{title}” is in the calendar of the area “{from}”. Only a date from this area's calendar can be the main date, so it will move to the calendar “{to}”. The same people see it as before; programme points go with it.
pick.noneHere: There's no such date in this area's calendar.

ask.title: “Write to us”
ask.has: It's on the main page. Who answers and from which forms people can write, you set in the page editor.
ask.says: A signed-up person writes to the organisers — only they and the person see this chat.
ask.placed: “Write to us” is on the main page.

chat.channelSays: Leaders write, everyone reads — including those signed up via the form.
chat.chatSays: Everyone in the area writes — and those signed up via the form.
chat.joined: Those signed up are in this chat.

roles.title: Roles
roles.says: A role gives access to the area — via a link or from a form. Creating a role and a link takes a dozen or so seconds.
roles.linkReady: The link is ready — copy it below.
roles.linksLater: You'll find the links later on the Access tab.

after.unlinkBody: The page stays and will be visible right away — it no longer waits for the end of the event.
after.title: After-event page
after.says: Hidden until the end of the event, then shown on the cards instead of sign-ups. A module on it can be only for participants with their own link — in the page editor: “Visible to”.
after.ready: The after-event page is ready — it will appear after the end.

archive.ended: Ended {date} — forms closed, the after-event page is visible.
archive.manual: You'll end it with the button below.
archive.autoNoTerm: It ends by itself an hour after the end of the main date — once you add one.
archive.auto: It ends by itself an hour after the end of the main date: forms close and the after-event page appears.
archive.endBody: Forms will stop accepting submissions and the after-event page will become visible. This can be undone (“Restore”).
archive.restoreBody: Forms closed at the end will accept submissions again, and you'll set the end manually later.
archive.title: End of the event
archive.willAuto: The event will end by itself.

lists.title: Lists on the main page
lists.says: Events and groups from this area and the areas in it — they fill in by themselves.
lists.added: The list “{name}” is on the main page.

act.participantsNotLinked: The participants' role wasn't linked to the form — you can do it in its settings.
act.needPointDay: Enter the day of the programme point.
act.mainAndTermFirst: Main page and main date first.
act.organisersNotAdded: The organisers' role wasn't added to those who answer — you can add it in the page editor.
act.formNotAttached: The sign-up form wasn't attached — you can attach it in the page editor.
act.attachForm: Attach the sign-up form in the page editor — without it nobody can write here.
act.chatNotJoined: The chat was created, but those signed up weren't added — use “Add those signed up”.
act.roleNotLinked: The role was created but not linked to the form — you can do it in its settings.
act.thanksBody: Thank you for being with us!
act.revisionPlaced: Its review is on the main page — people with the link learn there.
act.learnersRole: Learners' role (a dozen or so seconds)…
act.cantLetIn: You can't let anyone into the area “{name}” — ask whoever leads it, or choose a base from an area you lead.
act.baseNotRemembered: The server didn't remember this base for the course (a newer version is needed) — the course will show it as long as its module is on the main page.
act.noRevisionYet: The base has no review yet — create one in Learning (Reviews), then “Add to the page”.
act.revisionPlacedCourse: Its review is on the main page — answers go to the course.
act.baseNoRevision: This base has no review yet — create one in Learning (Reviews).
act.withoutRevision: {names} — no review. Create one in Learning (Reviews).

setting.plainSays: No card and no tools of a kind.
setting.removeBody: The area, pages, forms, dates and chats stay. The card disappears, and the area disappears from lists.
setting.changeBody: Everything in the area stays — the tools and the lists it appears on change.
setting.removed: The area is an ordinary area again.
setting.failed: Could not change the kind of the area.
setting.leader: The kind is changed by whoever leads the area.
setting.orJson: Or the whole area at once — pages, form, dates, roles, chats — from JSON prepared by an AI:
